    Profile

    Rosa is the daughter of an old noble family of Wratharis. Ever since she set foot into the torture chambers in the estate basements, she's had an attraction to cruel weaponry. It is said that when she indulges in her sadistic excitement, the Alchemia concentration heightens in her right eye, making it shine.

    Origin: Wratharis
    Gender: Female
    Height: 153cm
    Weight: 45kg
    Birthday: Jun 26
    Blood Type: Type Qe
    Zodiac: Moon of the Dark Magic Dragon
    Likes: Red and black
    Hobbies: Collecting weapons
    Illust: みかんあめ
    CV: 佐倉綾音
